sourceNote: Mega-era main expansion, 30 packs x 5 cards (Scrydex states the 30-pack count). Site sample: ~1,000 BOX. Per box: SAR ~28%; 3 AR GUARANTEED; SR ~80% plus 1 GUARANTEED Trainer-line SR (1.8 total); MUR ~1-2% (0.015 used); RR 4-5 (stated). RR per box (4-5) is stated by the source. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the samples are large (hundreds to thousands of boxes) and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the underlying tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by the box's pack count, which is separately sourced. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: the per-box guarantees (1 SAR/box on High Class, 3 AR/box, 1 ACE/box etc.) are folded into the slot rates above rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. The rates are per-box tallies divided by pack count, so a box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
